name: Looking after parents
title: Helping ageing parents with the things that matter
blurb: Medication, appointments and everyday routines, especially when you don't live nearby.
intro: Practical guides for when a mum or dad starts needing a little more help remembering things: tablets, appointments, bins and bills. Written for families, many of whom live miles away.

name: Reminders that get done
title: Reminders that actually get done
blurb: How to remind someone else, or yourself, without nagging or a phone full of alarms.
intro: Phone alarms only remind the person holding the phone. These guides cover what works when you need someone else to remember: WhatsApp, calendars, apps and the human side of not nagging.

name: Sharing the load at home
title: Sharing the load at home
blurb: Couples, flatmates, teenagers and pets: who remembers what, fairly.
intro: Bin day, rent, the dog's flea treatment, the pill, the boiler service. Guides to sharing the remembering at home so it doesn't all land on one person.

name: Living alone and staying safe
title: Living alone and staying safe
blurb: Check-ins, safety words and simple plans for people who live or work alone.
intro: Living alone, working alone, walking home alone or travelling solo. Calm, practical guides to making sure someone would notice if something went wrong.

name: Through the year
title: Reminders for every season
blurb: Clocks changing, winter, Christmas and the dates worth a reminder.
intro: Seasonal checklists and the moments in the year worth a reminder, for you and the people you look after.
